package handlers

import (
	"errors"
	"net/http"

	httpmw "github.com/example/ms-student-service/internal/transport/http/middleware"
	studentuc "github.com/example/ms-student-service/internal/usecase/student"
	"github.com/go-chi/chi/v5"
	"github.com/google/uuid"
)

func (handler StudentPracticeTaskHandler) SetPracticeTaskPublication(responseWriter http.ResponseWriter, request *http.Request) {
	studentID, _, ok := httpmw.UserFromContext(request.Context())
	if !ok {
		http.Error(responseWriter, "unauthorized", http.StatusUnauthorized)
		return
	}
	var payload struct {
		Visibility string `json:"visibility" validate:"required,oneof=private unlisted public"`
	}
	if err := decodeAndValidate(handler.Validator, request, &payload); err != nil {
		http.Error(responseWriter, err.Error(), http.StatusBadRequest)
		return
	}
	view, err := handler.Students.SetPracticeTaskPublicationVisibility(
		request.Context(), studentID, chi.URLParam(request, "id"), payload.Visibility,
	)
	if err != nil {
		var securityErr *studentuc.PublicationSecurityError
		if errors.As(err, &securityErr) {
			writeJSON(responseWriter, http.StatusUnprocessableEntity, map[string]any{
				"code": "PUBLICATION_SECRET_DETECTED", "message": securityErr.Error(), "findings": securityErr.Findings,
			})
			return
		}
		writeRuntimeError(responseWriter, err)
		return
	}
	responseWriter.Header().Set("Cache-Control", "no-store")
	if view == nil {
		writeJSON(responseWriter, http.StatusOK, map[string]any{"visibility": "private", "published": false})
		return
	}
	writeJSON(responseWriter, http.StatusOK, view)
}

func (handler StudentPracticeTaskHandler) GetPracticeTaskPublicationForOwner(responseWriter http.ResponseWriter, request *http.Request) {
	studentID, _, ok := httpmw.UserFromContext(request.Context())
	if !ok {
		http.Error(responseWriter, "unauthorized", http.StatusUnauthorized)
		return
	}
	view, err := handler.Students.GetPracticeTaskPublicationForOwner(
		request.Context(), studentID, chi.URLParam(request, "id"),
	)
	if err != nil {
		writeRuntimeError(responseWriter, err)
		return
	}
	responseWriter.Header().Set("Cache-Control", "no-store")
	writeJSON(responseWriter, http.StatusOK, view)
}

func (handler StudentPracticeTaskHandler) GetPublicPracticeTaskPublication(responseWriter http.ResponseWriter, request *http.Request) {
	view, err := handler.Students.GetPublicPracticeTaskPublication(request.Context(), chi.URLParam(request, "slug"))
	if err != nil {
		writeRuntimeError(responseWriter, err)
		return
	}
	responseWriter.Header().Set("Cache-Control", "no-store")
	writeJSON(responseWriter, http.StatusOK, view)
}

func (handler StudentPracticeTaskHandler) ListPublicStudentPracticeTaskPublications(responseWriter http.ResponseWriter, request *http.Request) {
	studentID := chi.URLParam(request, "studentID")
	if _, err := uuid.Parse(studentID); err != nil {
		http.Error(responseWriter, "not found", http.StatusNotFound)
		return
	}
	items, err := handler.Students.ListPublicPracticeTaskPublications(request.Context(), studentID)
	if err != nil {
		writeRuntimeError(responseWriter, err)
		return
	}
	responseWriter.Header().Set("Cache-Control", "no-store")
	writeJSON(responseWriter, http.StatusOK, map[string]any{"items": items})
}
